ticket.title: joiner fill: granular function synthesis with Silver and Gold DPO capture
ticket.description: Granular hole and function synthesis, so the loop can produce Gold DPO pairs once this lands. Credentials are already live: CLINE_API_KEY in .gaugeblock/.env and [sawhorse.providers.universal] in .gaugeblock/config.toml with ClinePass DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 active, so nothing here waits on an endpoint. Adds joiner fill <file> [--symbol <name>]: resolve the function via miter, request a candidate fill from sawhorse with LexicalScope context, gate it through batten validate, and emit a Silver trace on first-pass success or a Gold preference pair on a corrected retry (rejected = raw attempt, chosen = verified fix) through SpoolSink. Provider, model and key MUST come from the unified .gaugeblock/config.toml [sawhorse.default_model] and role overrides - no joiner-only credential flags and no second credential store. Size estimate: 150-220 LOC of production code plus roughly 60-80 lines of tests, because sawhorse, batten validation and the spool already exist; the new work is argument handling, one sawhorse call, one validate call and the pair-recording branch.

verification_receipt.summary: Closed on joiner main at f9a516b, developed on feat/joiner-fill. joiner fill <file> [--symbol] asks the hole_filler role for one function, validates against the workspace grammar table via miter_engine::polyglot::syntax_diagnostics, and retries exactly once with the diagnostics before failing; a first-attempt success spools Silver and a repaired success spools Gold carrying rejected_attempt, which is what makes it a DPO pair. Traces go through FileSpoolSink into .gaugeblock/spool/outbox.jsonl with content_hash and are written only on --apply. Verified live against the configured ClinePass provider: filling a stub add() returned a correct implementation in one attempt, tier silver, content_hash recorded, and --apply wrote it back to the file. Four tests cover brace-matched extraction, a missing symbol, fence stripping and syntax assessment. Gates: fmt, clippy -D warnings, nextest 26/26. Two corrections recorded: the sawhorse roles needed no change - hole_filler already had a provider and an earlier sed range made it look empty, so no config commit was needed; and the live run exposed that storypole writes a bare trace while joiner writes a SpoolEntry wrapper, filed as GB-182 because rabbet cannot ingest the bare form.
